newsitem.title: UK: Glickman-US will not accept gene crop segregation.
newsitem.headline: Glickman-US will not accept gene crop segregation.

text.p: The United States is not prepared to supply segregated supplies of genetically-modified crops in response to European demands for separate identifiable supplies which can be labelled, U.S. Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman said in London on Thursday.
"As long as these products prove safe we will not tolerate their segregation," Glickman said.
Speaking to the International Grains Council's conference in London, Glickman urged the use of biotechnology as a solution to the world's future food supply problems.
"We know that biotechnology holds out our greatest hope of dramatically increasing yields."

"I know biotechnology is an extremely sensitive issue in Europe," he said. But he stressed that the U.S. consumer movement was stronger than ever and underlined U.S consumers' confidence in science-based decisions on food safety.
"Sound science ought to be the only arbiter," he said. "The greatest threat to free trade is bad and phoney science." - - London Newsroom +44 171 542 7729
